data.long_meaning: Barad is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Barhana', which means 'thunder'. The name Barad carries the meaning “Lord of Thunder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Barad usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This is reflected in various Hindu myths and festivals, such as the annual monsoon-related celebrations.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its cultural importance, the name Barad carries spiritual significance. In Hinduism, the god associated with this name, Barad or Indra, is considered the god of rain and thunder, and the controller of weather patterns. He is believed to possess immense power and can bring both destruction and nourishment. By adopting the name Barad, one may invoke the qualities of strength, power, and divine protection associated with the god Indra and cultivate a deeper spiritual connection with this deity.
